name: Image macro captioning
summary: Two lines of white outlined capitals on a photo: a setup on top and a punch line below.
how: Set the font to Impact or an open look-alike such as Anton, in capitals.
Fill the text white and draw a black outline of 3 to 4px per 40px of text.
Place one line 5% to 8% from the top and one 5% to 8% from the bottom.
Size each line to 80% to 95% of the width.

origin.note: Forum users put white outlined Impact text on photos; the format spreads from imageboards.

adoptions.via: Imageboards and meme sites make the captioned photo a standard form.
Meme makers copy the bold caption into loud, recompressed pictures.
Meme makers put text labels on the people and objects of a stock photo to name their roles.
